name: LED sign behind you
what: A glowing dot-matrix LED sign on the wall behind you: the room’s lights drop with a flicker, the sign types itself out letter by letter (each letter flicking on) with a soft bloom, hums while it holds, then flickers off and the lights come back. 1-3 lines. The Editor puts it behind the person and moves it with the camera.
origin: MotionLab's own build of a common in-shot effect for talking-head videos: a glowing LED sign that types itself out behind the speaker (2026-10-27)
motion: f0-f8 the room's lights drop with a flicker (when dim is on) and the unlit panel of dots fades up (f0-f5); from f4 the letters light one after another (2.2 f apart at most, all lit within ~38 f), each on / off / on in 3-5 f, some twice; the hold hums (every dot shimmers) and one letter drops out twice for a frame mid-hold; the last 14 f the sign flickers and switches off (f-14 to f-7), the panel fades and the lights come back
